episode_title: S3 Ep28: GulfHost 2026 with The Ali Group

real_qa.q: What is the difference between GulfHost and Milan Host in terms of regional customer base?
real_qa.r: GulfHost 2026 is predominantly a regional show focused on the Middle East and GCC countries, though it has expanded to attract visitors from North Africa, India, and Central Asia. In contrast, Milan Host is considered the biggest show in the industry with a global reach. GulfHost started as a local show called Gulf Food and grew due to Dubai's reputation, eventually partnering with Host and alternating with Milan Host to become a truly regional event rather than just local.
real_qa.requete: GulfHost Dubai vs Milan Host regional differences

real_qa.q: What technology innovations are driving kitchen equipment design in professional foodservice?
real_qa.r: The primary innovations focus on energy saving, space saving, and smaller footprints. Induction cooking is becoming more prevalent due to energy costs. Equipment is getting smaller in size because kitchens are shrinking due to rising rents. Manufacturers are also prioritizing simplicity in usage through touchscreen interfaces described as intuitive, allowing users to see pictures of food and press buttons to cook automatically, while maintaining equipment that is simple to use, maintain, and keep clean.
real_qa.requete: kitchen equipment energy saving space saving technology 2026

real_qa.q: What is the efficiency difference between gas and induction cooking in professional kitchens?
real_qa.r: Gas burners have a maximum efficiency of 40 to 50 percent because the flame heats partially the pan and partially dissipates out of the pan. Induction has an average efficiency of 93 to 95 percent because the heat is focused directly on the pan. This significant difference makes induction much more energy efficient and faster than gas, though gas remains necessary for certain types of cooking requiring an open flame.
real_qa.requete: induction vs gas efficiency percentage professional kitchen

real_qa.q: How has GulfHost 2026 visitor profile changed compared to previous years?
real_qa.r: In 2026, GulfHost attracted more professional visitors including dealers, importers, and consultants rather than final end users. The balance has shifted from more balanced between final users and professionals two years ago to predominantly professionals in 2026. These visitors are described as serious buyers who know what they are doing, resulting in higher quality leads but lower overall volume compared to previous years when the show attracted wider ranges of scout visitors.
real_qa.requete: GulfHost 2026 visitors dealers consultants vs end users

real_qa.q: Why is regular equipment maintenance important for foodservice operators?
real_qa.r: People are holding equipment longer, similar to maintaining cars by changing oil regularly. If you take care of your equipment, your equipment will take care of you. This approach to preventive maintenance helps operators extend equipment lifespan and reliability, which is becoming increasingly important as the aftermarket service and maintenance of equipment becomes a key focus area in the hospitality industry over the next five years.

guest.bio_context: Raimondo Tonnellato is an international sales manager at Moreno (part of Ali Group), an Italian manufacturer of kitchen ranges, kitchen suites, and complete kitchen solutions. He oversees the Asia region, including the Middle East and Far East markets. He was present at GulfHost 2026 in Dubai representing Moreno's modular horizontal cooking equipment product line.
